title: UTSC BRIDGE: Excel Learning Series with Practice Datasets
eligibility_note: Open educational materials available to users inside and outside U of T; no Management enrolment requirement. Practice requires access to compatible spreadsheet software. No certificate is promised.
mapping_evidence: The series teaches Excel functions, calculations, data cleaning, organization and analysis using short videos, slides and practice spreadsheets.

title: UTSC BRIDGE: Excel Tables, Data Validation and Analysis ToolPak
eligibility_note: Open educational series; complete basic Excel training first. Some ToolPak and macro exercises require a compatible desktop Excel installation.
mapping_evidence: The intermediate series demonstrates Excel tables, advanced filters, data validation, ToolPak regression and sampling, and introductory macros.

title: UTSC Library: Foundational Data Literacy Skills Course
eligibility_note: Free self-paced course for undergraduate and graduate students and university staff; a community route is also linked. Exercises support Excel or Google Sheets. CCR requires all 10 modules, all quizzes and a one-page reflection. Quercus enrolment and completion were not tested.
mapping_evidence: The course uses Excel or Google Sheets for data cleaning, sorting and pivot tables, with 10 self-directed modules and quizzes. The Excel mapping applies to the Excel route; a Sheets-only completion does not establish Excel experience.

title: U of T Map & Data Library: R - An Introduction
eligibility_note: University library roadmap links a Quercus self-paced course. UTORid sign-in may be required; enrolment, fee and certificate conditions behind sign-in were not verified. No Management-only restriction is stated on the roadmap.
mapping_evidence: The library roadmap explicitly lists R - An Introduction as an online course under data analysis and programming. Use its R course link, not an expired live session.

title: U of T Map & Data Library: Data Visualization - Practice with Tableau
eligibility_note: University library roadmap links the Part 2 Tableau practice course in Quercus. UTORid sign-in may be required; enrolment, fees and software entitlement were not verified. No completion credential is promised.
mapping_evidence: The library lists Data Visualization - An Introduction, Part 2 - Practice with Tableau as an online course. Part 1 theory is complementary, not proof of Tableau practice.

title: U of T SciNet: DAT161 Introduction to Git Version Control
eligibility_note: SciNet lists non-graduate-course training as free. This self-paced course links to sign-in: use a CCDB account, or request access from courses@scinet.utoronto.ca if affiliated with a Canadian academic institution and unable to obtain one. Logged-in access was not tested.
mapping_evidence: SciNet explicitly lists DAT161 Intro to Git Version Control as a self-paced course.

title: U of T SciNet: Introduction to Programming in Python - Course Archive
eligibility_note: Free training archive, not a currently scheduled live class. SciNet says most past course recordings and slides are openly available; individual access may require guest access or login. Follow SCMP142 in the catalogue. No automatic certificate is promised.
mapping_evidence: The SciNet catalogue lists SCMP142 Introduction to Programming in Python and past offerings with course materials. This entry is an archive route, not a claim of current registration.

title: UTSC BRIDGE: FMI Foundations in Financial Modeling
eligibility_note: The university page advertises the Foundations program free for UTSC Management and Economics students using a U of T email. It describes a 15-hour program and online exam for a digital badge. Eligibility redemption was not tested. AFM accreditation and its exam are separate paid offerings; past scholarship deadlines do not establish a current offer.
mapping_evidence: The school describes financial modeling best practices, model design and financial statements. No current tool skill is assigned without explicit tool evidence; this is a finance exploration resource, not a tool-gap match.

title: U of T Library: Bloomberg Market Concepts Registration Guide
eligibility_note: UTM Library describes BMC as a free self-paced online program for U of T students using their university email. Actual account entitlement was not tested; follow the university instructions and verify before paying. Online course eligibility does not grant access to every campus terminal or other Bloomberg certificates.
mapping_evidence: The university guide describes financial-market modules and quizzes leading to a BMC certificate. Bloomberg is not in the current tool catalog, so no tool-gap skill is inferred.

title: U of T: Coursera Partner Consortium Access
eligibility_note: Official university access portal, not an individual course. Active U of T students may access selected offerings and completion certificates at no cost using mail.utoronto.ca. Catalogues can change; courses requesting payment may be outside the program. Current signed-in entitlement and individual courses were not tested.
mapping_evidence: The university describes access to selected Coursera courses. A general platform entitlement does not establish a Python, SQL or other tool mapping; individual courses need separate verification.

title: UTSC BRIDGE: Entrepreneurship Open Learning Series
eligibility_note: Free, publicly accessible self-paced modules welcome non-business students and community members. Interactive content includes worksheets and rubrics. No software entitlement, academic credit or completion certificate is assumed.
mapping_evidence: The five modules address entrepreneurship, value propositions, target markets and market research. This is direction exploration; no current tool skill is inferred.

title: Tableau: Superstore Sales and Profit Dashboard
eligibility_note: Official guided case; requires a suitable Tableau installation and the sample data. Check software licensing and publishing conditions for the chosen edition. Public sharing is optional; use sample rather than private data.
mapping_evidence: The tutorial builds sales and profitability views, a regional map, a dashboard and a story from the Superstore sample.

title: Kaggle Learn: Intro to SQL Exercises
eligibility_note: Kaggle lists the course at no cost. An account and access to the hosted exercise environment are needed to run and save work; setup was not tested. Uses BigQuery SQL; the tool mapping is SQL, not a broad GCP competency.
mapping_evidence: The course pairs lessons with exercises in SELECT, filtering, grouping, sorting, CTEs and joins using BigQuery.

title: Kaggle Learn: pandas Hands-on Challenges
eligibility_note: Recommended for learners with basic Python knowledge. A Kaggle account and hosted notebook access are needed for interactive work; account access and current terms were not tested.
mapping_evidence: The course provides short exercises in reading data, indexing, selection, summary functions, grouping and sorting using pandas.

title: Google Cloud: Query Public Data in BigQuery Sandbox
eligibility_note: Requires a Google account and Cloud project. BigQuery Sandbox can be used without a credit card or billing account, within its limits; it excludes features such as DML and streaming. Managed university accounts may have restrictions. Do not enable billing merely to complete this exercise.
mapping_evidence: The official sandbox guide introduces BigQuery console access and querying public datasets. The GCP mapping is introductory BigQuery exposure, not all Google Cloud services.

title: AWS: Query S3 Sample Data with Amazon Athena
eligibility_note: Requires an AWS account, appropriate permissions and an S3 query-results bucket. AWS explicitly states that tutorial queries incur charges; storage may also cost money. Not a default free exercise. Check costs and remove chargeable resources after use.
mapping_evidence: The AWS tutorial creates a database and table over sample S3 data, executes Athena queries and checks results. The AWS mapping is limited to this introductory workflow.

title: Microsoft Learn Lab: Explore Azure SQL Database
eligibility_note: Requires an Azure subscription with administrative-level access. Subscription charges may apply; verify the selected configuration and delete the lab resource group afterward. No free sandbox or university subscription is promised.
mapping_evidence: The official DP-900 lab provisions and explores Azure SQL Database and executes SQL against sample relational data.

title: Snowflake: Load Data and Run Analytical Queries
eligibility_note: Requires basic SQL and database concepts plus familiarity with CSV and JSON. The guide uses a time-limited Snowflake trial; verify current credit and billing conditions. Trial access is not permanent free access. Suspend compute and clean up resources after practice.
mapping_evidence: The lab creates warehouses and database objects, loads structured and semi-structured data, and runs analytical queries including joins.

title: The Python Tutorial
eligibility_note: Public tutorial for programmers who are new to Python; it assumes a basic understanding of programming and is not aimed at people new to programming. Running examples requires Python.
mapping_evidence: The tutorial introduces the basic concepts and features of the Python language.

title: 10 minutes to pandas
eligibility_note: Public documentation; hands-on examples require pandas and its dependencies.
mapping_evidence: The guide demonstrates pandas Series and DataFrame structures and basic operations.

title: NumPy: The Absolute Basics for Beginners
eligibility_note: Public documentation; running the examples requires NumPy.
mapping_evidence: The official guide teaches NumPy arrays and operations on its ndarray data structures.

title: Pyplot Tutorial
eligibility_note: Public documentation; running the examples requires Python and Matplotlib.
mapping_evidence: The tutorial introduces matplotlib.pyplot functions for creating and formatting plots.

title: An Introduction to R
eligibility_note: Public manual; hands-on practice requires an R installation.
mapping_evidence: The manual introduces R as a language and environment for statistical computing and graphics.

title: Getting Started
eligibility_note: Public documentation; examples require Python and scikit-learn.
mapping_evidence: The guide demonstrates scikit-learn estimators, fitting and prediction, and covers preprocessing, model selection, and evaluation.

title: PostgreSQL Tutorial
eligibility_note: Public tutorial; hands-on practice requires a PostgreSQL installation.
mapping_evidence: The tutorial explicitly introduces PostgreSQL, relational database concepts, and the SQL language.

title: SQL As Understood By SQLite
eligibility_note: Public SQL language reference; hands-on practice requires SQLite.
mapping_evidence: The SQLite reference documents supported SQL statements, syntax, and language features.

title: Power BI: Build a Financial Sample Report from Start to Finish
eligibility_note: Requires Power BI Desktop on a supported computer and basic familiarity with Excel and the Desktop interface. Local report creation and saving are sufficient; publishing requires a Power BI account and separate service access.
mapping_evidence: The tutorial transforms the financial sample, builds a data model and measures, and creates report visuals and a slicer.

title: Microsoft Excel: Create and Explore a PivotTable
eligibility_note: Public instructions; practice requires access to an Excel version supporting the described features. Use sample data. This is a guided tool exercise, not a certification or free Excel license.
mapping_evidence: The official guide demonstrates creating a PivotTable to summarize and analyze worksheet data.

title: Pro Git
eligibility_note: The book is publicly readable online.
mapping_evidence: The book covers Git installation and setup, repositories, recording changes, history, and branching.

title: Hello World
eligibility_note: A GitHub account is required. This teaches the GitHub repository and pull-request workflow, not a standalone command-line Git course.
mapping_evidence: This tutorial teaches GitHub essentials like repositories, branches, commits, and pull requests.

title: Learn the Basics
eligibility_note: Assumes basic familiarity with Python and deep-learning concepts. Public tutorial; run the code in Google Colab or install PyTorch and TorchVision locally.
mapping_evidence: The tutorial implements a machine-learning workflow using PyTorch, including data loading, model creation, optimization, and saving.

title: Quick Start
eligibility_note: Public tutorial; following along requires installing a packaged Spark release or PySpark.
mapping_evidence: The official quick start introduces Spark APIs in Python and Scala and demonstrates DataFrame-based analysis.

title: TensorFlow 2 Quickstart for Beginners
eligibility_note: Public tutorial; the page supports running its notebook in Google Colab or using a local Python environment.
mapping_evidence: The tutorial imports TensorFlow and uses it to train and evaluate a neural-network image classifier.
